from pathlib import Path
from hashlib import sha256
from difflib import unified_diff
from html.parser import HTMLParser
import json

class Links(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self, body):
        super().__init__()
        self.hrefs = []
        self.feed(body.decode('utf-8'))
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        self.hrefs.extend(value for name, value in attrs if name == 'href')

root = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-editor-example-placement')
base = (root / 'placement-live-readback.html').read_bytes()
preview = (root / 'director-buyer-preview/index-preview.html').read_bytes()
candidate = Path('products/sites/shopify-catalogue-example/index.html').read_bytes()
closing_tag = b'</body>'
assert sha256(base).hexdigest() == '8bb6898a489669b02cd4db20f10abbe524a2d87b4c4590d233b49d337eb83bcc'
assert sha256(preview).hexdigest() == 'c51c52bccd913d808ece4a7dec4d0a0bb13fbfd0c0ca201f30a9fd7eb62c0ab7'
assert base.count(closing_tag) == preview.count(closing_tag) == candidate.count(closing_tag) == 1
before, after = base.split(closing_tag)
assert preview.startswith(before) and preview.endswith(closing_tag + after)
addition = preview[len(before):-len(closing_tag + after)]
assert addition
merged = candidate if addition in candidate else candidate.replace(closing_tag, addition + closing_tag, 1)
assert merged.count(addition) == 1
if merged != candidate:
    assert merged.replace(addition, b'', 1) == candidate
assert Links(merged).hrefs == Links(candidate).hrefs == Links(base).hrefs
out = root / 'candidate-preserving-preview'
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(out / 'index-preview.html').write_bytes(merged)
(out / 'candidate.diff').write_text(''.join(unified_diff(candidate.decode().splitlines(keepends=True), merged.decode().splitlines(keepends=True), fromfile='current candidate', tofile='staged preview')), encoding='utf-8')
receipt = {'served_sha256': sha256(base).hexdigest(), 'candidate_sha256': sha256(candidate).hexdigest(), 'staged_sha256': sha256(merged).hexdigest(), 'added_example': merged != candidate, 'hrefs_equal_to_candidate_and_served': True, 'scope': 'Offline homepage preview only. Existing draft edits still require release-owner reconciliation.'}
(out / 'verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(receipt))
